title: Fun With Finlay

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Hey look can you take this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey look can you take this.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Hold on--let's go--wait, just act normal.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: 5... 4... 3... aannnddd we're good. Ok, thanks for that.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Holy unmoored tentacle beast I did! Thanks for letting me know.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: I have to or I'd forget and I can't forget because if I forget then it's all just forgotten! You know?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Zee? Why are you asking about Zee?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Oh so you're the new friend, got it. Well you can't be that good of a friend or you'd know she wouldn't want to be found right now. She's on one of her little 'resets'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh so you're the new friend, got it. Well you can't be that good of a friend or you'd know she wouldn't want to be found right now. She's on one of her little 'resets'.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Missing? You a new friend of Zee's or what? If you can't find her it's not that she's missing. She's on one of her little 'resets'. She don't wanna be found.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Missing? You a new friend of Zee's or what? If you can't find her it's not that she's missing. She's on one of her little 'resets'. She don't wanna be found.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: She takes off to the mountains, says they give her the best view to watch the sky kiss the sea. She does it every so often, just drops off and disappears. She'll be back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She takes off to the mountains, says they give her the best view to watch the sky kiss the sea. She does it every so often, just drops off and disappears. She'll be back.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: She knows the risks. That's the good thing about free will: you get to make your own decisions.
